# English words

Source: https://github.com/sindresorhus/word-list
Revision: 60b5059f4782080b1b254ac6cca46bb5eb4902ea (downloaded 2026-10-05).
The original words.txt is included unchanged. See english-words.LICENSE for its MIT license.

Texta uses this static list for local prefix completion and conservative spelling hints.
No keystrokes are sent to a dictionary service. The list loads separately from the application code.
Valid words, unfinished prefixes, capitalized names and ambiguous/unknown tokens are not marked as errors.
